description: Apply jurisdiction tax rates to line items and deliver the tax summary and a line-level audit. When a flat rate must be applied to a set of line items. Do not choose this when reduced rates, thresholds or cross-border rules apply. Example requests: Calculate VAT on these line items. | What is the tax and gross for this basket at the GB rate? | Apply the DE VAT rate to these lines.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

jurisdiction.description: The customer's jurisdiction.txt, as text. Supported: A short code. The tax jurisdiction code. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

line_items.description: The customer's items.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The line items. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

rates.description: The customer's rates.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'JURISDICTION=rate' per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
